programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: An event is organized at Ameerkot where Raj Mata tells Gayatri that at this event, the women of the Ameerkot play with 'Kumkum'. At the same time, Indravadhan reaches the scene with Badi Raani Maa and declares that the event will indeed be celebrated in a grand fashion. Gayatri on the other hand, decides to umask Badi Raani Maa at the event and expose her real face before Indravadhan. How will Gayatri unmask Badi Raani Maa? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Swarnlekha rushes to Indravadhan and begins crying, and she only utters the words Gayatri. Raj Mata and the rest of the family follow Swarnlekha and everybody are crying. An already shocked, Indravadhan is further shocked when guards bring Gayatri's body into the court. Gayatri is declared dead and Indravadhan tries to wake her up. Gayatri's parents reach Ameerkot and are all shocked hearing the heartbreaking news of their daughter's death. Indravadhan then declares that he would no more be the king of Ameerkot and asks Kuwar Singh, to become the new king of Ameerkot. Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out what happens ahead.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and hugs her. Seeing this, Sulakshana is left flabbergasted. She tells Indravadhan that he cannot do this. Sulakshana insults Gayatri which infuriates Indravadhan, who starts scolding Sulakshana. The argument draws Raj Mata and Badi Raani Maa to the scene. Indravadhan tells them that Sulakshana has changed and what she now wants is the title of the queen, whereas Gayatri wants love. Indravadhan declares that the next morning, he and Gayatri would leave the Raj Mahal. What will Sulakshana's reaction be hearing this statement? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: As planned by Sulakshana and Badi Raani Maa, a bomb is planted in Indravadhan's car and they wait for it to explode. To Badi Raani Maa and Sulakshan's surprise, Indravadhan and Gayatri escape alive. Seeing they are unharmed, Badi Raani Maa tells them that she heared the news of the bomb exploding. Later, Gayatri questions Badi Raani Maa about how she knew about the explosion. What answer will Badi Raani Maa's have for Gayatri? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri follows the woman wearing the black saree and realizes that she is none other than Badi Raani Maa. Gayatri is flabbergasted to realize the truth. Just as she learns the truth, she leaves the place but she is caught by Badi Raani Maa. Badi Raani Maa stops Gayatri and tells her the actual story and claims that she is not Indravadhan's grandmother. Will Gayatri reveal this truth to Indravadhan? Will he believe this? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Badi Raani Maa where Raani Maa shows her the wounds which confirm that whatever Gayatri saw was real. Badi Raani tells Gayatri that she wants to separate her and Indravadhan and that is the reason she is plotting all this. She even adds on that she has mixed poison in the 'Laddoos' which would be served to Indravadhan. Later, when Indravadhan is about to eat the 'Laddoos', Gayatri shows up in the scene and claims that the 'Laddoos' have been poisoned. What will Indravadhan's reaction be upon hearing this? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri takes Indravadhan to Badi Raani Maa's store room and shows him the skeleton of Sulakshana. Indravadhan is flabbergasted to hear that and uncovers the skeleton that was covered with a piece of cloth. At the same time, Badi Raani Maa reaches the scene and she has her hands tied up. Indravadhan unties Badi Raani Maa's hands as she reveals that Gayatri had tied her up. Gayatri is shocked to hear what Badi Raani Maa had just said and Indravadhan is also shocked hearing this. Badi Raani Maa also says that Gayatri wants to kill her and she is jealous of Sulakshana. Will Indravadhan believe in Badi Raani Maa's words? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri tells Raj Mata that Sulakshana and Badi Raani Maa are plotting against Indravadhan. Raj Mata tells Gayatri that she has a plan to work out. Raj Mata disguises herself and is able to fool Sulakshana. She draws Sulakshana to the treasure room where Gayatri is. She then locks Sulakshana up in the treasure room, where she confronts Gayatri. Sulakshana is flabbergasted to find Gayatri and questions her how she got out of. Sulakshana starts searching for her keys and then remembers that a servant had picked them up. What is Gayatri going to do with Sulakshana now? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaj Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan finally unmasks Sulakshana and finds that it is some other woman wearing the mask of Sulakshana. He gets infuriated learning the truth and starts choking the woman. Gayatri asks Indravadhan to stop hurting the woman. The woman tells Indravadhan that she is a dancer and she came here by herself as she got to know about Sulakshana. When Indravadhan is not satisfied with the woman's answers, he keeps her at gun point and asks her to tell the truth. Will the woman reveal that Badi Raani Maa is responsible? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri and Indravadhan meet Badi Raani Maa. Indravadhan apologizes to Badi Raani Maa for doubting her and promises that he would never doubt her anymore. Gayatri stands beside Indravadhan and tells herself that Badi Raani Maa is playing a game which Indravadhan is getting trapped in. Later, Indravadhan thinks back to when Badi raani Maa used to take care of him in his childhood. He tells himself that Badi Raani Maa has done a lot for him and now it is his turn to be a good grandson. Will Gayatri be able to explain Badi Raani Maa's real intentions to Ranaji? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and hugs her. Seeing this, Sulakshana is left flabbergasted. She tells Indravadhan that he cannot do this. Sulakshana insults Gayatri which infuriates Indravadhan, who starts scolding Sulakshana. The argument draws Raj Mata and Badi Raani Maa to the scene. Indravadhan tells them that Sulakshana has changed and what she now wants is the title of the queen, whereas Gayatri wants love. Indravadhan declares that the next morning, he and Gayatri would leave the Raj Mahal. What will Sulakshana's reaction be hearing this statement? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: As planned by Sulakshana and Badi Raani Maa, a bomb is planted in Indravadhan's car and they wait for it to explode. To Badi Raani Maa and Sulakshan's surprise, Indravadhan and Gayatri escape alive. Seeing they are unharmed, Badi Raani Maa tells them that she heared the news of the bomb exploding. Later, Gayatri questions Badi Raani Maa about how she knew about the explosion. What answer will Badi Raani Maa's have for Gayatri? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri follows the woman wearing the black saree and realizes that she is none other than Badi Raani Maa. Gayatri is flabbergasted to realize the truth. Just as she learns the truth, she leaves the place but she is caught by Badi Raani Maa. Badi Raani Maa stops Gayatri and tells her the actual story and claims that she is not Indravadhan's grandmother. Will Gayatri reveal this truth to Indravadhan? Will he believe this? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Badi Raani Maa where Raani Maa shows her the wounds which confirm that whatever Gayatri saw was real. Badi Raani tells Gayatri that she wants to separate her and Indravadhan and that is the reason she is plotting all this. She even adds on that she has mixed poison in the 'Laddoos' which would be served to Indravadhan. Later, when Indravadhan is about to eat the 'Laddoos', Gayatri shows up in the scene and claims that the 'Laddoos' have been poisoned. What will Indravadhan's reaction be upon hearing this? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri takes Indravadhan to Badi Raani Maa's store room and shows him the skeleton of Sulakshana. Indravadhan is flabbergasted to hear that and uncovers the skeleton that was covered with a piece of cloth. At the same time, Badi Raani Maa reaches the scene and she has her hands tied up. Indravadhan unties Badi Raani Maa's hands as she reveals that Gayatri had tied her up. Gayatri is shocked to hear what Badi Raani Maa had just said and Indravadhan is also shocked hearing this. Badi Raani Maa also says that Gayatri wants to kill her and she is jealous of Sulakshana. Will Indravadhan believe in Badi Raani Maa's words? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri tells Raj Mata that Sulakshana and Badi Raani Maa are plotting against Indravadhan. Raj Mata tells Gayatri that she has a plan to work out. Raj Mata disguises herself and is able to fool Sulakshana. She draws Sulakshana to the treasure room where Gayatri is. She then locks Sulakshana up in the treasure room, where she confronts Gayatri. Sulakshana is flabbergasted to find Gayatri and questions her how she got out of. Sulakshana starts searching for her keys and then remembers that a servant had picked them up. What is Gayatri going to do with Sulakshana now? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaj Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan finally unmasks Sulakshana and finds that it is some other woman wearing the mask of Sulakshana. He gets infuriated learning the truth and starts choking the woman. Gayatri asks Indravadhan to stop hurting the woman. The woman tells Indravadhan that she is a dancer and she came here by herself as she got to know about Sulakshana. When Indravadhan is not satisfied with the woman's answers, he keeps her at gun point and asks her to tell the truth. Will the woman reveal that Badi Raani Maa is responsible? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri and Indravadhan meet Badi Raani Maa. Indravadhan apologizes to Badi Raani Maa for doubting her and promises that he would never doubt her anymore. Gayatri stands beside Indravadhan and tells herself that Badi Raani Maa is playing a game which Indravadhan is getting trapped in. Later, Indravadhan thinks back to when Badi raani Maa used to take care of him in his childhood. He tells himself that Badi Raani Maa has done a lot for him and now it is his turn to be a good grandson. Will Gayatri be able to explain Badi Raani Maa's real intentions to Ranaji? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: An event is organized at Ameerkot where Raj Mata tells Gayatri that at this event, the women of the Ameerkot play with 'Kumkum'. At the same time, Indravadhan reaches the scene with Badi Raani Maa and declares that the event will indeed be celebrated in a grand fashion. Gayatri on the other hand, decides to umask Badi Raani Maa at the event and expose her real face before Indravadhan. How will Gayatri unmask Badi Raani Maa? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Swarnlekha rushes to Indravadhan and begins crying, and she only utters the words Gayatri. Raj Mata and the rest of the family follow Swarnlekha and everybody are crying. An already shocked, Indravadhan is further shocked when guards bring Gayatri's body into the court. Gayatri is declared dead and Indravadhan tries to wake her up. Gayatri's parents reach Ameerkot and are all shocked hearing the heartbreaking news of their daughter's death. Indravadhan then declares that he would no more be the king of Ameerkot and asks Kuwar Singh, to become the new king of Ameerkot. Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out what happens ahead.

programme.desc: An estranged couple battle for the custody of their only son.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: Complaint
programme.desc: A journey of a 12-year-old girl who visits the police station to report the disappearance of her bicycle. At the station, a police officer undertakes a heartwarming action to restore the child's trust, earning the admiration and faith of all those present. This incident serves as a powerful testament to our inherent, albeit sometimes unquestioning, belief in the police force.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Gunjaaish
programme.desc: A heartfelt journey of a couple raising a child with autism, discovering the power of love, resilience, and community. Featuring autistic actors, this ground breaking film celebrates acceptance and the beauty of being different.

programme.title: Doughnut
programme.desc: Sameer, on his afternoon break from work, walks into a restaurant hoping for some quiet time. However, a doughnut with supposedly magical properties has him in for a shock. Fearing the unreal powers he suddenly acquires, he hurries out. How does a young woman who walks in right then change Sameer's attitude towards the magical doughnut?

programme.title: Faatima
programme.desc: Faatima is a story of two unknown individuals who meet each other for the first time at a cafe and share with each other some very interesting facts only to make us realize that good souls do exist.

programme.title: Firki
programme.desc: It's the way many father's typically behave when their children start driving. The idea of using the navigation tool to highlight the generation gap is also based on my own life experience. The title is Firki because the family is spinning around like a Firki without having reached their destination in the film. It's also depicts how they've been taken for a ride by the navigation app, or as we say in Hindi....Firki le li

programme.title: Faboo
programme.desc: Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves. Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.

programme.title: Dhoop Haskar Boli
programme.desc: A determined daughter walks into a matrimonial office with her quiet, circumspect mother. What follows next is an awkward conversation with a charming executive and an inward journey for all three.

programme.title: First Sin
programme.desc: What would you do if you unexpectedly obtain magical powers? Ashwath, a failed businessman is having a troubled relationship with his wife . One fine morning he gets a Sand-timer at his door steps. Life takes a turn when he discovers magical powers in it. Will the Sand-timer be a boon or curse ?

programme.title: Fear Of Wheels
programme.desc: This film beautifully captures the emotional interplay between the vibrant, ambitious youth and the helpless, world-weary elders, showcasing the poignant struggle between generations. As a person reaches a certain stage in life, they observe numerous things happening around them, yet feel incapable of taking action. Over time, they become reliant on others even for the most basic tasks. This narrative portrays those individuals who experience old age gradually tightening its grip around them.

programme.title: Double Blind
programme.desc: A Rendezvous of childhood friends takes place in a dark alley of Mumbai, among the chaos and hustle of the city that never sleeps.

programme.title: Damdi
programme.desc: Damdi, is a story of a young boy. Whose parents left him in childhood, was pampered by her grandmother by working as a babysitter. Damdi has grown up and works in a garage, also studying together. A dear friend Paltan keeps warning him against good and evil. A garage owner Lallan bhaiya acts as a guide. Damdi is in love with a girl Gunja. He has an addiction and attraction towards intoxication, becoming the heart's weakness. Heartbreaks and despairs but returns to a new direction in life again.

programme.title: Destiny's Two
programme.desc: Mohan and his dwarf wife have come to Mumbai from Gujarat for his work. They are a newly wed couple. Their marriage is a compromise, as they do not see the spouse of their imagination in each other. Mohan who gets fascinated seeing taller women realizes the same about his wife. He decides to go to a red light area to fulfill his desire. But does he do it?

programme.title: Chup Chap
programme.desc: Following a newlywed couple enjoying a robust and empathetic bond, their world takes a turn during a party with friends, sparking a profound shift in their perspectives. Despite their differing opinions, both stand firm in their convictions. When an issue deeply troubles the wife, she bravely advocates for justice. After a prolonged battle, legal verdict is achieved. Yet, uncertainties linger about the truth behind this justice, leaving the tale shrouded in ambiguity.

programme.title: Game Of Caste
programme.desc: Game of Caste centers on Rakesh, an ordinary man visiting his aunt in her native village. He's initially captivated by the village's beauty but soon confronts a harsh reality: the mistreatment of a lower-caste boy by the villagers. This revelation shocks him, leading to his determined fight for the boy's rights. The overarching question remains: can he succeed in this battle between humanity and caste discrimination?

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: Marz
programme.desc: Rajeev is afflicted by an unusual illness, confounding even his doctor, who's encountering such a case for the first time. Is it a supernatural phenomenon or something within the confines of their home? Unravel the mystery in this quirky 14-minute narrative.

programme.title: Lock-Up
programme.desc: Inspector Maya Verma Has Just Arrested A Young Girl From The Red Light District. Kanchan Is Defiant And Unaffected, At First. A Conversation Between Them Leads To An Interesting Revelation. A Twisted Night With A Twisted End.

programme.title: Khalish
programme.desc: Everyday violence in the household plagues the childhood of a girl. The helplessness and anxiety that arises from such an experience builds in her as she grows up. Her aversion to authority manifests itself in extreme outcomes later.

programme.title: Khayaal Rakhna
programme.desc: A senior woman grapples with dementia, compelling her husband to confront challenging choices.

programme.title: Naam Badal Dena
programme.desc: A couple who is head over heels in love with each other with a love that's extraordinary yet relatable. The wife is told by everyone that she is too trusting of her husband. The wife makes a pact with her husband that if she ever acts like an ordinary suspecting wife he can change her name. The universe then puts her to the test on their wedding anniversary. The husband then makes her admit her true feelings as a wife and believe that possessiveness and jealousy in moderation are good.

programme.title: Meri Ramma Sabse Special
programme.desc: After a 15-year absence, Vikrant comes back home, only to be unexpectedly entangled in a web of unresolved issues and unspoken tensions with his mother. Confronting painful truths and reopening old wounds, he embarks on a quest for answers that could mend the fractured bonds between them. In this emotionally charged narrative, Vikrant must face his past to forge a brighter future and repair the ties strained by time.

programme.title: Mestri
programme.desc: The man is displaying the behaviour of a thug. He receives calls similar to those of Abbas Khan. Along his journey, he follows a couple in their mid-twenties. Initially, they appear in Christian attire, then in Gujarati attire. Later, they appear in Muslim attire. one day the thug catches both of them. And he confronts them in front of Abbas Khan. At that time, there was a confrontation between the thug and Abbas Khan regarding money. At that time, the real story was revealed.

programme.title: Hausla
programme.desc: Danish, a village boy with kabaddi dreams, faces adversity as he's unfairly removed from his team due to a dispute he didn't start. Despite family discord, his father stands by him. A new opportunity arises, showcasing Danish's talent. He's selected for the biggest game of his life, but tragedy strikes: his father passes away. Will Danish find the strength to play on, honoring his father's memory?

programme.title: Meri Bebbe
programme.desc: Based on true events, this poignant tale follows a young boy navigating life after losing his father and the unwavering efforts of his single mother to raise him against all odds.

programme.title: Khwahishon Ki Car
programme.desc: A newlywed longs to drive her dowry car, but is stalled by her husband's ego and her mother-in-law’s control. The Driver’s Seat is a quiet rebellion about agency, freedom, and the fight to take control—on the road and in life.

programme.title: Jevlas Ka
programme.desc: A gym freak eagerly awaits his cheat day, but family drama and an empty wallet stand in his way. As he navigates the chaos of Mumbai, will he find a way to satisfy his cravings, or will the city serve up an even bigger surprise? A fun-filled ride of food, family, and unexpected twists!

programme.title: Laxmi
programme.desc: Laxmi works as a maid at the house of a couple. She reaches home early only to find the owners of the house dead. She panics and tells her boyfriend about this. He thinks of a plan and tells her to rob the jewelry and cash from the house. Will she be able to do it? or is she falling for a trap?

programme.title: It's A Match!
programme.desc: Saurabh gets a match on a dating app and enlists his friend Shobhit’s help. But when Shobhit steals the spotlight—and the girl—things take a hilarious turn. Lies unravel, friendships are tested, and just when you think it's over… another match changes everything! A fun-filled tale of love, loyalty, and second chances

programme.title: Nazariyaa
programme.desc: Mihika, a 22 year old, fights with her dad yet again over going out late at night. She finds it very unreasonable of him to be so worried now that she’s 22. Waiting for her cab, she overhears her building’s supervisor talking on a phone call with his own daughter. She steps in and debates with him about how he shouldn’t be upset about her being out late at night but understands his perspective too in the process. She then goes back home to apologise and reconcile with her dad. The supervisor also understands his daughter’s situation better through this chance encounter.

programme.title: Late Lateef
programme.desc: Amir, who is in his mid-20s, is struggling with self-doubt and feeling trapped in his work routine. Unfortunately, his habit of being consistently late has caused him to fall out of favor with many people, including himself. This has created a vicious cycle that he has been unable to break free from despite his best efforts. However, having a supportive inner voice has been a great blessing for him as he tries to push through his struggles.

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Love has many things hidden instore. What happens and Why does it happen? The secrets will be revealed in Kidnapped

programme.title: Dimming Shadows
programme.desc: The husband and wife both suffer from dementia, but with the help of a compassionate doctor and nurse, they make an effort to recover. Unfortunately, their attempts are unsuccessful, but their daughter finds solace in visualizing her parents as alive through virtual reality

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Kshan
programme.desc: After a dinner-time discussion about mental health turns sour, Kamlesh (55) riles his daughter, Disha, a clinical psychologist, into storming off from the gathering. This incites Kamlesh into visiting three doors to his past that make him realise that he himself suffers from a mental health disorder. 'Kshan' is a recollection of a broken man's traumatic events and his realisation that drives him to seek help from his daughter after learning to let go of his ego.

programme.title: Nathania
programme.desc: One evening a couple, Kishan and Aparna reach home to witness what they have feared the most. This compels them to take the most critical decision of their life. Will they be able to live with the practical decision they make?

programme.title: L'idiot
programme.desc: L’Idiot tells the story of Rinku, a young, eccentric man who is captivated by French culture and hopelessly infatuated with Mona, a charismatic and free-spirited girl in his language class. His romantic fantasies and attempts to impress Mona take a comedic yet dark twist when he encounters a mysterious “thief,” who manipulates Rinku into a dubious scheme to win Mona’s affection. Rinku’s innocent longing for friendship and love leads him into an awkward and ultimately dangerous pursuit.

programme.title: Mere Shohar Ki Begam
programme.desc: Javed already married but still he wants second marriage. His first wife Rukhsar opposed him, he beats her and second day he gets his second wife Afsana at home. Because of jealousy, bitterness revenge game starts between both wives.

programme.title: Ek Chhoti Si Lift Story
programme.desc: A shy office worker’s silent crush blossoms inside an elevator, where missed chances and quiet longing test his courage to finally speak.

programme.title: Raah
programme.desc: Raah is an exploration of the several stages of struggle when one steps out to pursue a dream. Sahir lives in Mumbai city with his family. The emotional and poetic narrative explores his faith, kinship and his struggle to establish himself as a poet/writer.

programme.title: Saas
programme.desc: After the death of a loved one, young Yatin takes on the responsibility of caring for his ailing mother-in-law. As he prioritizes her well-being, he faces numerous hardships, intertwining their lives unexpectedly.

programme.title: Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

programme.title: Pendulum
programme.desc: After losing his fiancée, Vishu is drowning in grief, unable to see a way forward. On the verge of giving up, a mysterious encounter changes everything, offering him a new perspective on life. Will he embrace the second chance fate has given him?

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Thank You For Sharing
programme.desc: This dark topical narrates the story of Jude, who's been suffering from psychosis, a mental health illness & has an aberrational relation with the voice in his head.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: A sweet, endearing tale of two old school lovers and their conversations, carried out over shy, fond letters creating an emotional heart touching last letter.

programme.title: The Bench
programme.desc: A young man’s monotonous life turns upside down when he meets a stranger on a bench.

programme.title: Omlette
programme.desc: After being unable to contact her son Rohan and her daughter-in-law for days, Anupama visits Rohan’s place to find out the reason behind this unusual behaviour and an evening full of tension and emotions lead to a shocking end to her search.

programme.title: Naam Kya Hai
programme.desc: Set in the 1992 riots in Mumbai, "Naam Kya Hai?" revolves around a distraught and prejudiced police officer trying to avenge the murder of his wife amidst the communal tension in the city.

programme.title: Eelu Rani Bhag Gaye
programme.desc: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

programme.title: Yathaarth
programme.desc: A time travel story of a husband & wife who revisit their past memories through a new technology called Alternate Reality Correction Services, thinking they can resolve their own issues through it.

programme.title: Husbands
programme.desc: When Aadav visits his ex-wife’s house to give his son a gift, he is greeted at the door by Satvik, the man who has replaced him in his ex's life, and maybe even his son’s.

programme.desc: Rakesh, a virgin, is set up by his friends with an escort, Madhu(who happens to be a psychology student). They both have opposite thoughts on sex and a debate ensues between them over the course of the night and then finally what happens between them.

programme.desc: A story of love and courage that strives to sustain amidst a communally-charged environment.

programme.desc: An old man living a life full of mistakes gets an extraordinary experience only to realize that he is the ultimate creator of his destiny.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

programme.title: Night Courier
programme.desc: From a struggling delivery man to the depths of a city's underworld, where desperation and opportunity collide, and this tantalizing opportunity comes at a great cost. Fahad a mentally fragile man racing against time must risk everything he holds dear, including his principles and the fragile sanity he clings to.

programme.title: Room 203
programme.desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Aileen Wuornos: American Boogeywoman
programme.desc: True Story that follows America’s most notorious Female Serial killer. Based on Aileen Wuorno’s early life. Back in 1976 a young Aileen arrives in Florida searching for a new life, marries a wealthy yacht club president to start as part of Florida’s high society. Tormented by her inner demons she surrenders to her murderous impulses havoc in the peaceful community.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?

Through their determination, they discover the strength of the human spirit, inspiring others to join their fight for justice. With a powerful cast and storyline, sheds light on important social issues and the fight for women's rights. Will these women succeed in creating a better future for themselves and future generations?

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani’s lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore’S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore’.Tagore’S Words And Basu’S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we’ll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: The Good Boss
programme.desc: What makes a good boss? Charming yet manipulative, he meddles in employees’ lives and crosses every line. Javier Bardem stars in this darkly comic tale where ambition sparks chaos with unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: Terrorists kidnap Russian Prime Minister's 2 kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant & threaten to blow up reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in and they are world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A Young couple thinking about buying their perfect single family starter home. They visits a real estate agency where they are received by a strange sales agent and find themselves trapped in a surreal, mysterious, maze-like nightmare.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: This timeless tale was originally written in 1757. Could Beauty ever love the ghastly lord, the Beast? Only true love can break the spell.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Based on the bestseller The Room, Corner Office follows a man lost in corporate absurdity. As he climbs the ladder, he finds a secret room that “doesn’t exist,” spiraling deeper into alienation and surreal humor.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: A female assassin takes on covert global missions no government will admit to. Hunted worldwide, she must use all her skills to survive and eliminate the final thread of a deadly conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Jurassic Attack
programme.desc: A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

programme.title: King Lear
programme.desc: Set in a fictional present, King Lear explores what it means to be human—cruelty, love, and loss. Chaos unfolds when an aging king gives power to his corrupt daughters and rejects the only one who truly loves him.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Ghum Hai Kisikey Pyaar Meiin
programme.desc: Sai loses her cool and blames Pakhi for eyeing Virat. The Chavans are left shocked when Sai discloses Pakhi and Virat's old connection.

programme.title: Rat Trap
programme.desc: The episode follows Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) as they settle into their respective family homes. The initial "pampering phase" (where parents cook your favorite meals and do your laundry) ends abruptly, replaced by the suffocating routine and expectations they once ran away from.

programme.title: Old Dots, New Lines
programme.desc: While still in their respective hometowns, Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) encounter people from their past. The episode highlights the awkward friction that occurs when you realize your old friends have either stayed exactly the same or changed in ways you can no longer relate to.

programme.title: Sisterhood
programme.desc: The episode explores the complex, multi-generational layers of female relationships. It’s not just about the friendship between the two leads, but about the "sisterhood" they share with their mothers and the realization that their mothers were once young, ambitious, and confused women too.

programme.title: Out Of Office
programme.desc: The title "Out Of Office" is a play on their professional status, but it more accurately reflects their mental state. They’ve been "out of office" from their Mumbai lives for long enough to gain a new perspective. The episode focuses on the inevitable departure and the emotional weight of saying goodbye—this time with the maturity of adults who know exactly what they are going back to.

programme.title: Nero The Hero
programme.desc: The episode opens with a camera crew following Neerav Kapoor (Nero) as he prepares for his day. Within the first five minutes, it becomes clear that Nero doesn't just want to be an actor; he believes he is already a legendary craftsman who simply hasn't been "discovered" yet.

programme.title: The Tables Turn
programme.desc: The episode explores the concept of "Networking." Nero believes that his talent is so undeniable that if he can just get in front of the right person, the "tables will turn," and he will go from a nobody to a superstar. This leads him to infiltrate a high-profile industry event where he is, unsurprisingly, not fit.

programme.title: The Agony Aunt
programme.desc: Nero realizes that being a great actor isn't just about performing; it’s about observation and mentorship. He decides to take it upon himself to solve the "emotional blocks" of everyone around him, believing that his vast experience in playing fictional characters makes him an expert in real-world psychology.

programme.title: Superheroes
programme.desc: Nero becomes obsessed with the idea that he is the perfect fit for a "desi" superhero franchise. He doesn't wait for a script or a casting call; he decides to live the life of a superhero to "absorb the essence" of the character. This leads to some of the most cringeworthy "public" moments in the entire series.

programme.title: Getting Functional
programme.desc: Nero becomes convinced that the secret to becoming a superstar lies in "Physical Functionality." He decides that his body needs to be a fine-tuned instrument capable of any physical feat, leading him to join a CrossFit-style gym. However, in true Nero fashion, he doesn't just work out—he turns the gym into a stage for his "performative athleticism."

programme.title: In-House Talent
programme.desc: Nero is faced with a harsh reality: his bank account is empty, and his "blockbuster" hasn't arrived. He decides to grace a small-scale, in-house corporate production with his "legendary" presence. He views this as a charitable act—a superstar helping out the common folk—but the corporate team views him as a total nightmare.

programme.title: Reflections Of Blood
programme.desc: Nero decides that the mainstream industry is too "small-minded" to understand his vision. He takes on the role of Writer, Director, and Lead Actor to produce an avant-garde short film titled Reflections of Blood.

programme.title: Equal Rights
programme.desc: Nero realizes that "socially conscious" cinema is the current trend in the industry. He decides that to be a true "Hero," he needs to stand up for the marginalized. However, because it's Nero, he manages to turn a fight for "Equal Rights" into a self-centered campaign for "Actor’s Rights."

programme.title: High Is Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The title is a classic Nero-ism—a mangled version of "All's Well That Ends Well," infused with his obsession with "vibrations" and high-frequency living. In this finale, Nero is faced with the ultimate test: a real, high-stakes opportunity that requires him to be... normal.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The documentary crew follows a rare moment of "crisis" in Nero’s life. His landlord has had enough of the "acting workshops" (noise) and unpaid dues. Nero, however, refuses to see this as a tragedy; he views it as the "Second Act" of his biopic where the hero hits rock bottom before the inevitable rise.

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Arun realizes he can’t win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. The episode focuses on the recruitment of a "misfit" squad: Prachi: A badminton player struggling with an injury. Jeetu: A delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes. Adil: A young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge. Raunak: A volatile but highly skilled "fragger." The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals (and their skeptical families) that they have what it takes to be pros.99999999999

programme.title: Noobde (noobs)
programme.desc: The team has assembled, but the chemistry is non-existent. Raunak’s ego clashes with the other members, and the group struggles to put their personal issues aside during practice. Arun has to step up not just as a player, but as a coach, to teach them that in Esports, individual brilliance is useless without team synergy. This episode highlights the "grind" of professional gaming and the steep learning curve.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.desc: This video comically portrays the various awkward situations that arise between young adults and their parents. It highlights relatable moments of parental overprotectiveness, unintentional embarrassments, and the generational gap in understanding.

programme.title: Indian Parents During Winters
programme.desc: From “put on more clothes” to the thermostat wars, random health advice and the dramatic shift in household routines—winter reveals a whole new set of parent-modes.

programme.title: Little Things Couples Do
programme.desc: The video highlights the small, sweet moments couples share in daily life. It shows how these little gestures make relationships special.

programme.title: Things Girl Roommates Do
programme.desc: Two (or more) female roommates navigate shared spaces, stealing each other’s snacks, borrowing clothes, gossip sessions and midnight chats. The video captures both the chaos and comfort of living with a girl-friend as a roomie.

programme.title: Life Of A Working Mother
programme.desc: The video portrays the challenges of balancing work and motherhood. It highlights her multitasking, sacrifices, and the love that drives her daily life.

programme.title: Moms During Board Exams
programme.desc: The dramatic shift a mom undergoes when her kid has board exams – transforming into a coach, counselor, cook, motivator, and sometimes panic-stricken overseer. Every worry, prayer, and pep talk is amplified in those days.

programme.title: Things You Shouldn't Say To Your Partner
programme.desc: Funny, awkward and borderline-dangerous phrases that one says to a partner (often unintentionally) that trigger eye-rolls, fights or long silences. The video shows how what we say matters — even when we don’t intend.

programme.title: Every Wedding Prep Ever (aka Shaadi Ki Taiyari)
programme.desc: Indian wedding planning is a tornado of outfit stress, nosy relatives, budget nightmares, and endless last-minute drama—all under one roof.

programme.title: Siblings: Expectation Vs Reality
programme.desc: What you want from your sibling (support and affection) rarely matches what you get (teasing, stealing food, and dramatic arguments). Yet somehow, love peeks through the chaos.

programme.title: When You Date A Malayali
programme.desc: This video humorously explores the distinctive characteristics and experiences of dating a Malayali individual. It highlights their cultural pride, love for Malayalam cinema and unique expressions, all in a comical and relatable manner.

programme.title: Signs That She Is The One
programme.desc: The video highlights the little signs that show yur partner is the one for you. It showcases sweet gestures, understanding, and moments of connection that make a relationship feel perfect.

programme.title: Struggles Of People With Pcod / Pcos
programme.desc: A candid, humorous look at the daily frustrations, symptoms, and misconceptions people with PCOD/PCOS face.

programme.title: Little Ways To Say I Love You (valentine's Day Special)
programme.desc: Tiny, everyday gestures that speak volumes — surprise breakfast, a handwritten note, a random hug — reminding us romance isn’t always big gestures. The video paints Valentine’s Day not just as one grand move but many small ones.

programme.title: Secret Romance
programme.desc: The thrill of hiding your love: quick texts, hushed meet-ups, the adrenaline of being “not obvious,” and the worry that your friends (or worse, parents) might accidentally spill everything.

programme.title: Reality Of Being A New Mom
programme.desc: The video follows Ishani, who enters motherhood with a Pinterest-perfect plan, only to be hit by the hilariously chaotic reality of a newborn. Through a series of quick-cut "Before vs. After" moments, we see her transition from a woman who had time for 10-step skincare routines to someone who considers "dry shampoo and a clean burp cloth" a luxury.

programme.title: When You Move To A New School
programme.desc: You walk into a new campus, new faces, that first lunch break all alone, trying to find your clique, dread of “where do I sit?”, the hope that maybe this one will be better.

programme.title: When Opposites Fall In Love
programme.desc: The introvert meets extrovert love story—proof that sometimes total opposites make the most perfect match.

programme.title: When Your Younger Sibling Is Excited For Diwali
programme.desc: This video comically portrays the overwhelming excitement of a younger sibling for Diwali, contrasting it with the older sibling's more subdued reactions. It highlights the preparations, decorations, and anticipation for the festival through their contrasting perspectives.

programme.title: Childhood Memories We'll Never Forget
programme.desc: This Children's Day special video highlights the cherished and relatable childhood memories that individuals hold dear. It showcases heartwarming moments such as learning to spell, enjoying imaginary boat rides, and the innocent joys of growing up.

programme.title: When You Live To Eat
programme.desc: A tribute to every foodie who plans their day, mood, and relationships around food.

programme.title: If You Could Build Your Partner
programme.desc: he video humorously explores the concept of having a "perfect partner" that can be designed to cater to all your needs, from knowing your moods to always being available. It highlights the imagined benefits and eventual drawbacks of such a relationship

programme.title: Neighborhood Romance
programme.desc: The video humorously depicts the charm and awkwardness of a budding neighbourhood romance. It highlights shy glances, small gestures, and the playful moments that make a neighbourhood romance feel sweet and relatable.

programme.title: Elder Sister Vs. Younger Sister
programme.desc: A more nuanced look into the “big sis vs little sis” world: one is protective, the other wants freedom; one sets rules, the other finds ways around them—but both can’t live without each other.

programme.title: Every Arranged Love Story
programme.desc: The video humorously depicts the initial awkwardness and eventual blossoming of love in an arranged marriage setting. It showcases the couple's journey from their first meeting to gradually understanding and falling for each other, highlighting the challenges and cute moments along the way

programme.title: Every Sister Should Have A Brother Like Him
programme.desc: A brother who’s protective, fun, annoying, helpful — the kind you’d pick if you could choose. The video highlights the ideal (funny-ideal) brother that makes sisterhood richer.

programme.title: Other People Vs Gujaratis
programme.desc: Stereotypes, pride, and amusing exaggerations around Gujarati culture — how “outsiders” see Gujaratis vs how Gujaratis see themselves. The video plays with accents, food, shopping habits, and family dynamics.

programme.title: Every School Romance
programme.desc: The video captures the innocent, awkward, and heartwarming moments of school romances. It highlights the shy glances, small gestures, and playful memories that make young love so special.

programme.title: College Ke Aakhri Din
programme.desc: The video captures the bittersweet emotions of the last day of college. It highlights the nostalgia, friendships, and heartfelt goodbyes that make this milestone unforgettable.

programme.title: When You Think Everything Is A Sign
programme.desc: You find meaning in random coincidences: the phone rings right when you were thinking of someone, the song you disliked plays, you see an old number—so you start believing the universe is “talking” to you.

programme.title: Every Men's Haircut Ever
programme.desc: From insisting on “just a trim” to miraculously gaining ten inches of hair, this video pokes fun at the clichés every guy goes through at the salon. It captures the disconnect between what men ask for and what they actually get.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Older Than You
programme.desc: The dynamic of having a bestie who’s your mentor, life coach, and chaos partner rolled into one.

programme.title: Story Of Every Average Student
programme.desc: A heartfelt and humorous take on school life for the “average” student: not top of the class, not bottom either—just navigating expectations, grades, fun and the invisible stress of staying “good enough”.

programme.title: Things Single Women Have To Deal With
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the everyday struggles single women face. It highlights societal questions, unwanted advice, and the funny situations that come with being single.
